archetypes.name: delegation-errors
archetypes.rationale: Process substitution <(phase_driver_read_result_env ...) silently drops exit codes; errors from the delegated parser may go undetected, allowing a silent empty-output-file success.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the delegation pattern in scripts/read-result-env.sh where phase_driver_read_result_env is called via process substitution and its output is piped into a while-read loop. In Bash, the exit code of a process substitution is not automatically propagated to the calling script, so if phase_driver_read_result_env fails internally the while loop reads empty input, the output file is written empty, and the script exits 0. Determine whether any mechanism exists to detect and surface this failure, and whether the documented exit-code table in read-result-env.md still holds under delegated-parser failure. Also check whether the two-pass file read (replay_warn_error then phase_driver_read_result_env) creates a TOCTOU window or output inconsistency if the source file is modified between passes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash32-compat
archetypes.rationale: The diff introduces indexed-array syntax and sources lib-phase-driver.sh; BASH_AUTHORING.md strictly forbids Bash 4+ constructs and the sourced library is now a runtime dependency.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit scripts/read-result-env.sh for Bash 3.2 compatibility as required by BASH_AUTHORING.md. Check that ALLOW_KEYS_ARRAY=() and ALLOW_KEYS_ARRAY+=(...) are valid in Bash 3.2, and that the source call to skills/design/scripts/lib-phase-driver.sh does not pull in any Bash 4+ constructs (declare -A, declare -n/local -n, mapfile/readarray, ${var^^} case-conversion, or &>> redirection) via phase_driver_read_result_env or any helper it calls. Verify that process substitution <(phase_driver_read_result_env ...) is supported in Bash 3.2, and confirm the computed _RRE_SCRIPT_DIR path correctly resolves the relative ../skills/design/scripts/ path at runtime. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: behavioral-regression
archetypes.rationale: Malformed-line and CR-value handling changed from hard exit-1 to silent skip; callers relying on strict failure to detect bad input or avoid sourcing a partial output file may silently regress.
archetypes.prompt_body: The diff changes scripts/read-result-env.sh so that nonblank lines without '=' and values containing CR bytes are now silently skipped rather than causing exit 1. Identify all callers of scripts/read-result-env.sh in the repository and determine whether any rely on the strict failure to propagate bad-input errors upstream or to prevent sourcing a partial output file. Check whether the updated read-result-env.md accurately describes the new skip semantics and whether scripts/test-read-result-env.sh covers mixed-input files where valid KVs coexist with malformed lines alongside WARN/ERROR replay lines in the same input. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
